hospital.name: San Antonio Regional Hospital (Emergency Department)
hospital.snippet: San Antonio Regional Hospital's Randall and Janell Lewis Emergency Department serves the community with 24-hour emergency care and is located at 999 San Bernardino Road, Upland, California 91786.

police.name: Rancho Cucamonga Police Department (San Bernardino County Sheriff's Department)
police.snippet: Since incorporation in 1977, law enforcement services in the City have been provided through a contract with the San Bernardino County Sheriff's Department.
